A jungle strip hacked from dense plant-element canopy, rough tan plates running between buttress-root slope bricks, a carved stone idol head half-swallowed by vine elements at the threshold, a fabric wind cone on a bamboo bar mast, and a brick parrot perched on the idol's brow wearing a tiny leather aviator cap.

A mesa-top strip of pale tan plates ringed by sheer slope-brick walls dropping to empty air, a rope-and-plank lift rigged on a hand-cranked winch drum over the sheer edge, a corrugated arch hangar braced against the cliff, and a brick lizard sunning itself flat across the winch drum crank.

A village street closed for an air race, bunting studs slung in looping arcs between shuttered yellow and red brick houses, plain painted pylon cones marking the hairpin turn at the cobblestone square, a crowd-rail of tan plates thick with minifigures, and a brick cat fast asleep across the very centre of the strip.

An ice-floe edge strip of white snow plates with trans-blue lead cracks splitting the verge, round-brick fuel drums half-buried in slope-brick snowdrifts, a fabric wind cone frozen rigid on its bar mast, and a brick seal balanced on a drum lid balancing a fish element on its nose.

A volcano-rim survey strip of grey stepped plates above a wide trans-orange crater glow, a corrugated arch hangar braced and chained to rock-slope bricks on the uphill side, drum stacks roped to iron cleats, a brass bell on a stone-brick plinth at the threshold, and a brick gecko clinging to the bell's underside.

A treetop platform strip of brown plank plates lashed between four enormous plant-element trunks, rope-clip guardrails strung along both long edges, a hand-cranked winch drum at the upwind head, and a brick toucan on the wind-cone mast gripping a single red round-stud cherry in its enormous beak.

A frozen-lake strip of white plates between two squat ice-fishing-hut bricks, a dog-sled team in harness at the western verge with brick huskies mid-lunge, round-brick fuel drums chained in a row, a fabric wind cone on a bar mast, and the lead husky wearing a small printed bow tie element.

A fossil-dig strip of tan plates beside a half-excavated brick skeleton whose ribcage arches directly under the strip centreline, wooden trestle frames bracketing the dig trench, a fabric wind cone on a bamboo bar mast, and a brick crow sitting inside the skeleton's open skull cavity holding a small pick element.

A flying-circus field of green plate mosaic beside a red-and-white striped big-top of curved slope bricks, a cannon of round bricks aimed skyward at a steep angle, bunting studs strung between tent-pole bar masts, and a brick clown in full printed costume handing a lit torch element up toward the cannon mouth.

A lighthouse headland strip of grey stepped plates ending at a sheer brick edge above trans-blue water plates, a white-and-red striped round-brick lighthouse at the cliff corner, a corrugated arch hangar with hinged doors beside it, and a brick puffin standing at the very edge of the last plate row, looking straight down.

A rooftop strip of light-bley apron tiles on a broad city brick block, a red round-brick water tower at one corner, washing-line bars strung between two chimneys trailing printed tile laundry, round-brick fuel drums near the stair-head, and a brick pigeon sitting in an empty fuel drum with its printed eyes half-closed.

A windmill field of patchwork green and amber plate mosaic, a turning brick sail-wheel at the upwind strip head with bar-and-clip vanes catching the breeze, a low hedge-plate border running down the near side, a plain painted pylon cone at each corner, and a brick mouse riding the lowest sail arm with both C-hands gripping tight.

A desert dry-lake strip of smooth tan plates ringed by slope-brick buttes in deep orange and rust, a lone signal cannon of round bricks aimed skyward on a pivot plate, round-brick fuel drums in a shaded alcove, a fabric wind cone locked stiff on its bar mast, and a brick rattlesnake coiled around the cannon barrel.

A golden-age pylon race course over stubble plates of yellow and tan, plain painted cones in vivid scarlet on bar-mounted brackets at each turn, a spectator rail of white-plate fencing thick with cheering minifigures, and a brick dog sitting in the front row wearing a pair of tiny goggles on its printed snout.

A wheat strip flanked by rows of round golden-plate hay-bale bricks stacked two high, a scarecrow minifigure lashed to a bar mast with outstretched C-hands, a fabric wind cone above it, a wheeled fuel trolley parked at the verge, and a brick crow sitting on the scarecrow's hat regarding it with open contempt.

A mountain-pass strip on a narrow stepped-brick shelf between towering grey slope-brick peaks, a rope bridge of bar-and-clip spans crossing a chasm at the upwind end, a brass bell on a stone-brick plinth at the threshold, round-brick fuel drums roped to the cliff face, and a brick yak standing on the bell plinth licking it.

An atoll strip of pale tan plates beside a plank-plate floatplane ramp sloping into trans-blue water plates, a wrecked hull of dark-bley brick half-submerged at the ramp edge, a fabric wind cone on a driftwood bar mast, and a brick crab standing on the wreck's bow with one claw raised like a tiny salute.

A market-town aerodrome behind a five-bar gate on clip hinges, a produce cart loaded with printed-tile vegetables parked at the fence beside a brick horse, a corrugated arch hangar with flung-open hinged doors, a plain painted pylon cone at each gate post, and a brick rooster standing on the gate's top bar crowing at the strip.

A snowbound strip of white plate mosaic beside a log-cabin of brown plank bricks with a smoking chimney of grey slope bricks, a laden dog-sled piled with crate bricks at the verge, round-brick fuel drums buried to their lids in snow, and a brick rabbit sitting on the chimney top perfectly warmed by the drifting smoke.

A circus-train field of green plate mosaic where a vivid yellow-and-red brick carriage sits magnificently derailed beside the strip, its hinged doors hanging open, bunting studs strung from the carriage roof to a bar mast, a plain painted pylon cone at the strip head, and a brick monkey hanging from the bunting by one C-hand.

A stilted delta strip of brown plank plates raised on column bricks above trans-blue water plates, fishing nets on bar-and-clip frames draped between stilts at both edges, a fabric wind cone on a mast at the seaward end, and a brick frog sitting inside a fishing-net loop staring up at the underside of the plank surface.

A quarry-floor strip of grey plates between sheer rock-slope walls of dark stone bricks, a stone crane arm of bracket plates swung out over the strip edge above the drop, round-brick fuel drums lined at the base of the wall, a fabric wind cone on a bar mast, and a brick owl perched on the crane's pivot pin.

An orchard strip of green plate mosaic between rows of plant-element apple trees heavy with round red stud-fruit, laden wooden crate bricks stacked three high at the verge, a fabric wind cone on a blossomed branch used as a mast, and a brick hedgehog sitting atop the highest crate with a single red stud apple impaled on a spine.

A canyon-floor strip of tan plates between soaring slope-brick sandstone walls in orange and rust, a rope bridge of bar-and-clip spans swaying overhead between the canyon rims, round-brick fuel drums in a shadowed alcove, a plain painted pylon cone at the threshold, and a brick vulture perched on the rope bridge's highest clip regarding the strip below.

A seaside pier-end strip of brown plank plates extending over trans-blue water plates, a helter-skelter of curved slope bricks in red and yellow spiral behind the landward end, a fabric wind cone on an iron bar mast at the pier tip, and a brick seagull standing on the helter-skelter's topmost point holding a chip element.
